title: Budgets and Financial Plans
seo_title: Grade 7 Budgets and Financial Plans Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 budgeting worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: allowance plans, saving for a goal, family budgets, percent saved and needs and wants. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A financial plan (budget) shows the money that comes in (income) and how it will be used (expenses and savings).
  • Income − expenses = money left for savings.
  • Use percentages to plan: 20% of a ₱1,000 allowance for savings is ₱200.
  • Pay for needs (food, rent, school) before wants. Set a savings goal and a time: goal ÷ weeks = amount to save each week.

Examples

Example

Save for a ₱2,400 item in 8 weeks

2,400 ÷ 8

Answer: ₱300 a week

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Spent instead of leftSubtract the expenses from the income.
Dividing the wrong wayGoal ÷ amount per week = number of weeks.
Wants before needsPlan the needs first.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 7 ask about financial plans?

faq.a: A simple plan: about 50% for needs, 30% for wants and 20% for savings.

faq.q: Why save a percent of income?
faq.a: It grows with your income and builds a habit.

faq.q: What should an emergency fund cover?
faq.a: A few months of needs, like food, rent and bills.
